page.layout: One blank page: no printed text, only the discoloured paper, stains and fibres of the scan. No columns, no margins, no notes.
page.notes: The scan shows a blank leaf with uneven browning and speckles, toward the edges darker. No printed words, numbers, signatures, catchwords or running heads can be read. Faint grain resembling print lines is paper texture or show-through, not transcribable text.
